thread:
tara: Quick bakeoff update — ran GPTQ / AWQ / INT8 / FP8 across Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B this week. Dropping topline + brief notes here.

devin: TL;DR? would love a one-paragraph summary. :prayer_hands:

tara: TL;DR — GPTQ is the safest generalist pick: smallest mean accuracy delta vs FP32 with the best memory reduction for deploys. AWQ can match or slightly beat GPTQ on Mistral gen workloads but shows instability on long-context/instruction chains (token repeats / early truncation). INT8 gives best throughput and predictable latency but increases small hallucination rates on instruction tasks. FP8 looked promising for dense-matrix throughput but inconsistent across families; needs more per-layer tuning.

aj: Can you paste the quick metrics (MMLU / Vicuna / perf) so we can decide which to promote to Dedicated?

tara: Sure — kept it compact (FP32 baseline vs quant). All numbers are delta relative to FP32 unless noted. Runs on A100-40GB.

Tara: Llama2-13B — MMLU: FP32 74.2 | GPTQ 73.9 (-0.3) | AWQ 73.5 (-0.7) | INT8 72.9 (-1.3)
Tara: Llama2-13B — Vicuna-200 (winrate): FP32 62.5 | GPTQ 61.9 (-0.6) | AWQ 61.2 (-1.3) | INT8 60.8 (-1.7)
Tara: Llama2-13B — perf (tokens/sec @batch=4): FP32 220 | GPTQ 410 | AWQ 430 | INT8 680

Tara: Mistral-7B — MMLU: FP32 69.1 | GPTQ 68.7 (-0.4) | AWQ 69.0 (-0.1) | INT8 67.8 (-1.3)
Tara: Mistral-7B — Vicuna-200: FP32 58.3 | GPTQ 57.9 (-0.4) | AWQ 58.6 (+0.3) [note: instability] | INT8 57.2 (-1.1)
Tara: Mistral-7B — perf (tokens/sec @batch=8): FP32 320 | GPTQ 610 | AWQ 640 | INT8 980

Tara: Qwen-7B — MMLU: FP32 70.8 | GPTQ 70.5 (-0.3) | AWQ 69.9 (-0.9) | INT8 70.1 (-0.7)
Tara: Qwen-7B — Vicuna-200: FP32 60.0 | GPTQ 59.8 (-0.2) | AWQ 59.0 (-1.0) | INT8 59.5 (-0.5)
Tara: Qwen-7B — perf (tokens/sec @batch=4): FP32 210 | GPTQ 380 | AWQ 395 | INT8 720

maria: Nice. Memory footprints? that matters for Dedicated sizing.

tara: Approx peak GPU mmapped memory on A100-40 (inference resident):
Tara: Llama2-13B: FP32 ~26GB | GPTQ ~11GB | AWQ ~10.5GB | INT8 ~8.5GB
Tara: Mistral-7B: FP32 ~22GB | GPTQ ~9.5GB | AWQ ~9.2GB | INT8 ~7.8GB
Tara: Qwen-7B: FP32 ~23GB | GPTQ ~10.2GB | AWQ ~9.8GB | INT8 ~8.0GB

sanjay: You mentioned instability on Mistral AWQ — can you surface the concrete symptom and logs?

tara: Yes — reproducible on our long-context instruction suite (avg prompt length 6k tokens). Symptoms: repeated token loop and premature EOS at ~2048 when using AWQ with KV broadcast enabled. Not seen for same config in GPTQ. Short log snippet: 

```
[2026-03-15 11:02:14] mistral-awq-run: prompt_len=6120 ctx_cache=enabled kv_broadcast=on
[2026-03-15 11:02:16] decode: loop_detected=3 token_repeat_window=24 truncation_reason=early_eos
[2026-03-15 11:02:16] stack: aten::quantize_linear -> matmul -> split_kv
```

Tara: Quick repro command: `run_bake --model mistral-7b --quant awq --seed 42 --context 8192 --kv-broadcast`

devin: Is this likely a quantization numeric edge-case (per-layer scale blowup) or runtime kernel bug?

tara: Initial investigation points to per-attention-head scaling variance in AWQ on Mistral that interacts poorly with our KV sharding broadcast path. Could be numeric + layout kernel mismatch. Need targeted per-layer histograms from the quantizer.

aj: For rollout recommendations: which quant do we pin to Dedicated for each family?

tara: Short recommendation — for now:
- Llama2-13B: pin GPTQ for Dedicated (best accuracy + good perf).
- Mistral-7B: pin GPTQ on Dedicated; AWQ can be allowed on Hosted for non-long-context low-latency gen, but gate AWQ for long-context until we fix repeat regression.
- Qwen-7B: GPTQ preferred; INT8 can be promoted to throughput clusters where slight accuracy loss is acceptable.

maria: Ops notes for Dedicated: add canary that runs long-context instruction eval on every AWQ rollout for Mistral and fail if repeat rate > 1.5%

bakebot: auto-measure: added canary job `awq-mistral-longctx` to infra, will run on next push and post results to #eng-oncall.

devin: Action items?

tara: Actions — short list:
1) @aj + @sanjay: produce per-layer quant histograms for AWQ on Mistral (3 seed runs) by EOD Tue.
2) @devin: schedule Dedicated canary to auto-fail AWQ on long-context >1.5% repetition.
3) @maria: size Dedicated pools based on GPTQ footprints (we expect ~10GB per model on A100-40).
4) @tara: run AWQ seed sweep (seeds 1,2,3,42) for the 8k-context suite; collect telemetry.

sanjay: acked, starting histograms now. will post artifact link when ready.

tara: one more note — AWQ gave a small but consistent improvement on Mistral sample quality in short-dialog (Vicuna) in human A/B — so still interesting for hosted low-latency gen offering. Keep it in the stack. :sparkles:
